name: TinyZKP Pricing Calculator
summary: A buyer-facing estimator for choosing between Free, Developer, Pro, Scale, Compute, and pilot review based on workflow, monthly proof receipt volume, typical trace size, and verifier visibility.

workflow.label: Agent tool call or workflow checkpoint
workflow.guidance: Start Free or Developer while receipts are internal; move to Pro when agent outputs expose receipt URLs to users.

workflow.label: Agent platform or workflow-engine rollout
workflow.guidance: Use the $5,000 production pilot before platform rollout because the decision depends on receipt policy, verifier placement, support expectations, and distribution.

workflow.label: Backend API mutation
workflow.guidance: Start Developer for one production workflow; move to Pro or Scale when receipts attach to recurring customer-visible mutations.

workflow.label: Audit, reserve, or reconciliation checkpoint
workflow.guidance: Use Pro or Scale for recurring checkpoints; use Compute for long traces or backfills.

workflow.label: Long trace or backfill
workflow.guidance: Use Compute when paying per trace step is better than operating high-RAM prover infrastructure.

workflow.label: Reserved capacity or procurement review
workflow.guidance: Use pilot review for contractual terms, reserved workers, procurement packets, support commitments, or custom state-machine boundaries.

external_verifier_visible.guidance: Set true when a customer, auditor, marketplace, agent supervisor, or external recipient sees the receipt URL or receipt object.

recommendation_rules: If workflow is platform, recommend the $5,000 production pilot before a sales-assisted platform rollout.
If workflow is enterprise, recommend pilot review.
If receipts are internal, volume is at most 100 per month, and workflow is not long-trace, recommend Free.
If workflow is long-trace, or the trace band is large or xl, prefer Compute when it is within 15% of the best uncapped Pro or Scale estimate, or when no self-serve plan fits without hitting a cap.
For recurring customer-visible API or agent receipts above 250 per month, prefer Pro when it fits without reaching the cap.
For high-volume customer-visible receipts above 3,500 per month, prefer Scale when it fits without reaching the cap.
For audit workflows above 2,500 receipts per month, prefer Scale when it fits; otherwise prefer Pro when it fits.
If all self-serve plans reach their spend caps and Compute is not the right workload shape, recommend pilot review.
